background: Standard Chartered PLC is the London-listed holding company of a bank whose business is almost entirely in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, earning from corporate and institutional banking, trade finance and wealth management.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, A- on average and the weakest at BBB+, one on a positive outlook and one stable. Capital is in line with UK majors, CET1 of 13.8% at the peer median and leverage of 4.6% below it, while liquidity is better, with LCR of 157% and NSFR of 135% both above the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026.
